places.name: Kaziranga National Park (UNESCO Site)
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, home to the one-horned rhinoceros and diverse wildlife.
places.place_tip: Book safaris in advance for the best experience.

attribution.title: Beauty of Kaziranga National Park
attribution.author: Diganta Talukdar
attribution.description: An adult male one horned rhino takes shelter on highland during flood  at Kaziranga National Park in Bagori range of Nagaon district of Assam

places.name: Majuli River Island
places.ai_summary: The world's largest river island, known for its unique culture, satras, and scenic beauty.
places.place_tip: Visit the satras to learn about Assamese culture.

attribution.title: Doriya River of Majuli
attribution.author: Dhrubazaan Photography
attribution.description:
A Mishing tribe woman is carrying out wetland grasses on her boat from wetlands near Doriya River of Majuli Island in North Eastern State Assam, India  on a sunny day morning. 
Wetland grasses are good food for their pets to increase the production of milk. Selling Dairy/Milk of their pets like cows, buffaloes is the mainstream business for few communities in Assam and India.

places.name: Kamakhya Temple (Guwahati)
places.ai_summary: A revered Hindu temple dedicated to Goddess Kamakhya, located atop the Nilachal Hill.
places.place_tip: Avoid visiting during peak hours to skip long queues.

attribution.title: Kamakhya Temple - DEV 8829
attribution.author: Devkmaravi
attribution.description: Kamakhya Temple, Nilanchal Hill, Kamrup/Guwahati, Assam

places.name: Umananda Temple (Peacock Island)
places.ai_summary: A sacred Hindu temple on an island in the Brahmaputra River, dedicated to Lord Shiva.

opening_hours.notes: Boat rides are subject to river conditions.

places.place_tip: Combine with a river cruise for a complete experience.

attribution.title: Chandrasekhar Temple, Umananda
attribution.author: Extreminatethejuice
attribution.description: Chandrasekhar Temple located adjacent to Umananda Temple constructed by Ahom king Chandrakanta Singha in c.1820 CE.

places.name: Sivasagar Ahom Monuments
places.ai_summary: Historical monuments of the Ahom dynasty, including temples and palaces, located in Sivasagar.
places.place_tip: Hire a guide to explore the history and architecture.

attribution.title: Sivasagar Night View
attribution.author: Shyam Kaanu
attribution.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication

places.name: Manas National Park
places.ai_summary: A national park and UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for its biodiversity and conservation efforts.

opening_hours.notes: Jeep safaris and elephant rides available.

places.place_tip: Stay in nearby resorts for a complete wildlife experience.

attribution.title: Manas landscape rhino
attribution.author: AmAnand
attribution.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication

places.name: Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary
places.ai_summary: A wildlife sanctuary known for its population of the Indian rhinoceros and rich biodiversity.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored by jeep or elephant safari.

places.place_tip: Visit early morning or late afternoon for best wildlife sightings.

attribution.title: Indian Rhino in Pobitora
attribution.author: Biswarup Sen

places.name: Haflong Hill Station
places.ai_summary: The only hill station in Assam, known for its scenic beauty and pleasant climate.
places.place_tip: Explore nearby villages for a glimpse of local life.

attribution.title: Synod view point, Haflong
attribution.author: JyotiPN
attribution.description: এইটো অসমৰ ডিমা হাছাও জিলাৰ সদৰ ঠাই হাফলঙৰ এটি ভিউ পইন্ট। ই সাগৰপৃষ্ঠৰ পৰা ৫৯৩ মিটাৰ উচ্চতাত অৱস্থিত। ইয়াৰপৰা হাফলং চহৰখনৰ কিছু অংশ দেখা পোৱা যায়।

places.name: Digboi Oil Refinery Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the history of the oil industry in Assam, located in Digboi.
places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby Digboi War Cemetery.

attribution.title: Digboi Centenary Museum 04
attribution.author: Subhashish Panigrahi
attribution.description: Digboi Centenary Museum was established by Assam Oil Company (part of Indian Oil) to commemorate the history the oil industies in the valley of Assam. This museum was opened behind the oil refinery at Digboi in early 2002. Many of the old and preserved machinery are there in this museum.

places.name: Guwahati Planetarium
places.ai_summary: A modern planetarium in Guwahati, offering shows and exhibits on astronomy and space science.
places.place_tip: Check the show schedule in advance.

attribution.title: Guwahati citysky
attribution.author: Rituraj Bhuyan from Guwahati, India
attribution.description:
City view from the Gandhimandap, Guwahati.

Looks great when viewed large !

places.name: Assam State Zoo & Botanical Garden
places.ai_summary: A large zoo and botanical garden in Guwahati, home to a variety of animals and plants.
places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby Botanical Garden.

attribution.title: Rhino at Assam State Zoo
attribution.author: D. Konwar User:dkonwar
attribution.description: The great Indian one-horned Rhino photographed in Assam State Zoo, Guwahati

places.name: Sualkuchi Silk Village
places.ai_summary: A village famous for its traditional silk weaving, located near the Brahmaputra River.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the silk weaving season.

places.place_tip: Purchase silk products directly from the weavers.

places.name: Dibrugarh Tea Estates
places.ai_summary: Tea estates in Dibrugarh, known for producing some of the finest Assam tea.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the tea plucking season.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about tea processing.

attribution.title: New Dibrugarh Railway Station Complex
attribution.author: I Love Assam

places.name: Bihu Festival Grounds
places.ai_summary: Grounds in Guwahati where the Bihu festival is celebrated with traditional dance and music.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the Bihu festival.

places.place_tip: Participate in the Bihu celebrations for an immersive experience.

places.name: Hajo Pilgrimage Town
places.ai_summary: A pilgrimage town with historical temples and mosques, located on the banks of the Brahmaputra River.
places.place_tip: Explore the various temples and mosques for a complete experience.

attribution.title: Great Buddha Statue, Bodh Gaya
attribution.author: Andrew Moore from Johannesburg, South Africa

places.name: Chandubi Lake
places.ai_summary: A serene lake located near Guwahati, ideal for picnics and nature walks.
places.place_tip: Carry packed food and water for a picnic by the lake.

attribution.title: Chandubi Lake, Assam
attribution.author: Prof. Vikramjit Kakati
attribution.description: Chandubi Lake was formed on 12 June 1897 at the evening Assam earthquake. During that period the forest went down and became the lake.

places.name: Kakochang Waterfalls
places.ai_summary: A beautiful waterfall located near the Kaziranga National Park, ideal for a day trip.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the monsoon for a fuller waterfall.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to Kaziranga National Park.

places.name: Dipor Bil Bird Sanctuary
places.ai_summary: A bird sanctuary and wetland area near Guwahati, ideal for bird watching and photography.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the migratory season.

places.place_tip: Carry binoculars and a camera for bird watching.

attribution.title: Deepor beel
attribution.author: Renzut
attribution.description: Deepor beel is an avian wildlife protected area in Assam, India.

places.name: Tocklai Tea Research Institute
places.ai_summary: A tea research institute in Jorhat, known for its extensive tea gardens and research facilities.
places.place_tip: Learn about the different varieties of tea and their cultivation.

attribution.title: Tocklai gate jorhat
attribution.author: Official anahita
attribution.description: This photo shows the gateway to the Tocklai Experimental Station in Jorhat, Assam, India.

places.name: Ugro Tara Temple
places.ai_summary: A Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, located on a hilltop with panoramic views.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the hill climb.
